parties.petitioner: Navneet Kaur Harbhajansing Kundles @ Navneet Kaur Ravi Rana

summary: Caste certificate validity contested; 'Mochi-Scheduled Caste' claim via Punjab migration; Scrutiny Committee validated based on 1932 tenancy indenture and college certificate; High Court quashed as fraudulent; standard: Presidential Order 1950 restricts recognized castes; no judicial amendment to caste lists; documents alleged forged; fraud determination requires factual examination by quasi-judicial body; limited writ jurisdiction in certification disputes.
legal_provisions_cited: Maharashtra Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, De-Notified Tribes (Vimukta Jatis), Nomadic Tribes, Other Backward Classes and Special Backward Category (Regulation of Issuance and Verification of) Caste Certificate Act, 2000
